subject: a floating moss garden in a porcelain basin
art_direction: 低处漂浮的白瓷浅盆盛着小片苔藓星园，远方只有淡淡弧光。
visible_description: 低处漂浮的白瓷浅盆盛着小片苔藓星园，远方只有淡淡弧光。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Float a shallow ivory porcelain basin in the lower half of a muted cosmic field. Inside it, a miniature moss garden forms soft green hills around one smooth stone, illuminated by a distant pale arc. Render glaze thickness, tiny moss fibers and a restrained underside shadow. The scene feels tender and impossible, without spacecraft, labels or busy star patterns. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
